profile.name: Keerthan Tunkoju
profile.title: Entry-Level Software Developer | AI & ML Graduate
profile.intro: AI/ML-focused Computer Science graduate and practicing GIS Engineer with experience in spatial data digitization, topology validation, and urban infrastructure mapping.

paragraphs: AI/ML-focused Computer Science graduate and practicing GIS Engineer with experience in spatial data digitization, topology validation, and urban infrastructure mapping.

Delivered end-to-end projects spanning convolutional neural networks for medical imaging and ML-driven agricultural prediction models. Currently contributing to large-scale urban GIS initiatives at NeoGeoInfo Technologies using ArcGIS, QGIS, and Google Earth.

experience.title: GIS Engineer
bullets: Perform utilities digitization of roads, footpaths, electric networks, drainage, water bodies, parks, and government properties for urban infrastructure projects.
Execute spatial data validation and topology correction to ensure geometric integrity and compliance with project standards.
Conduct attribute QA/QC using Excel, verifying data completeness, consistency, and accuracy across GIS layers.
Create and manage GIS layers for multi-stakeholder urban projects, ensuring high-accuracy data delivery on time.
Digitized urban infrastructure layers including roads, footpaths, electric network, drainage, water bodies, parks, buildings, and land parcels for the Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC).
Performed topology validation, attribute accuracy checks, and basemap correction using ArcGIS, QGIS, Google Earth, and Global Mapper.
Delivered an accurate, production-ready urban GIS database supporting city planning and infrastructure management.

experience.title: Python Programming Intern
bullets: Built a feature-complete To-Do List application in Python with task add, delete, and persistence functionality.
Developed a GUI-based Calculator handling arithmetic, floating-point, and error edge cases.
Implemented a Password Generator with configurable length, character sets, and entropy-based strength scoring.

experience.title: Web Developer Intern
bullets: Designed and deployed a personal Portfolio website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript showcasing projects and skills.
Built a Temperature Converter tool supporting Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin conversions with real-time UI feedback.
Recreated the Netflix homepage as a responsive UI exercise, demonstrating CSS layout and component structuring.

experience.title: Web Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a full Hotel website frontend using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript including booking UI, gallery, and contact form.
Completed structured industrial training covering modern front-end development workflows and best practices.

projects.name: Crop Yield Prediction Using Machine Learning
projects.shortDesc: ML pipeline predicting crop yields from soil, weather, and historical agricultural data.
projects.fullDesc: Designed and implemented an ML pipeline to predict crop yields based on soil type, weather conditions, crop management practices, and historical records, targeting a key challenge for India's agriculture-dependent economy.
features: Applied and benchmarked multiple supervised learning techniques to model non-linear relationships between input features and crop yield output.
Addressed key limitations of neural network approaches including relative error reduction and prediction efficiency.
Synthesized a systematic review of AI-based Crop Yield Prediction (CYP) methods to inform model design.

projects.name: Deep Learning Methods for Identifying Brain Tumors
projects.shortDesc: CNN-based semantic segmentation of brain MRI scans to automate tumor detection.
projects.fullDesc: Built deep learning models using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and watershed algorithms to perform automated semantic segmentation of brain MRI images, reducing the manual burden of clinical image analysis.
features: Trained and evaluated CNN architectures on the BraTS dataset, tuning regularization and hyperparameters for segmentation accuracy.
Deployed a web application to expose the trained models to medical practitioners for point-of-care inference.
Addressed spatial and structural heterogeneity in brain tumors to build a dependable automated segmentation pipeline.

education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (AI & ML)
education.institution: Sri Indu Institute of Engineering & Technology
details: Relevant coursework: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Structures & Algorithms, Database Management Systems, Computer Networks.
